name: Super Tool Automotive Inc.
what_they_do: Full-service auto repair and tire shop: brakes, diagnostics, transmission and diesel repair, suspension/steering, alignments, tires, oil service, plus fleet maintenance and Penske truck rentals. NAPA AutoCare Center and AAA Approved Auto Repair facility operating since 1996.
customers: Local drivers in New Brunswick/North Brunswick/Somerset, NAPA and AAA members, and commercial fleets.

size_signals.signal: In business since 1996 as a NAPA AutoCare Center with ASE-certified technicians
Live jobs page (hiring) and a separate Fleet Services line of business
123 reviews on Birdeye; amenities advertised include early-bird drop-off, local shuttle, Wi-Fi and coffee

listing.platform: Birdeye aggregate (Google reviews) plus AAA Approved Auto Repair listing

website_review.primary_cta: 'Schedule My Service' (nav) and 'Call Now'; tire lookup widget; coupons page
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Service request form only - the page states the submitted time is not guaranteed and staff reply within 24 hours; Google reCAPTCHA on the form
website_review.trust_signals: NAPA AutoCare Center, AAA Approved Auto Repair, ASE certification, NAPA Peace of Mind warranty page, financing options, branded shop photos, coupons
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Net Driven template: no LocalBusiness/AutoRepair schema (only an Organization block with name and logo); 'Reviews' page merely links out to Google/SureCritic instead of showing ratings; site hours 8:00-5:30 differ from AAA's listed 9-6
website_review.search_basics: Title names the service and town ('Auto Repair & Tire Shop in New Brunswick, NJ'); each service has its own page under /Auto-Repair/cat/...; robots.txt explicitly allows OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Googlebot while blocking only scraping/training bots like Bytespider and Amazonbot
top_issues: Scheduling is a request form with reCAPTCHA and a 24-hour callback promise - not bookable
No LocalBusiness/AutoRepair schema with address, hours, geo or services
Customer reviews are not readable on the site, only linked out
Hours inconsistent between the site and the AAA listing

agent_readiness.notes: Very AI-friendly robots.txt (search bots allowed under the wildcard, plus explicit allow groups for ChatGPT-User/Claude-User/Google-Agent), clean local title/meta, deep service pages, and hours/address as text. But JSON-LD is an Organization stub only - no LocalBusiness, openingHours, geo or aggregateRating - and reviews are not on-page. Booking is blocked twice: Google reCAPTCHA plus a form that says the chosen time is not reserved, with a 24-hour manual confirmation.

operations_signals.signal: Site tells customers a submitted appointment time is not guaranteed and staff 'will be in touch within 24 hours' - a manual confirmation queue on every request
Fleet accounts plus Penske truck rentals add scheduling, invoicing and dispatch admin on top of retail repair
Hiring page is live, suggesting growth or turnover and limited spare admin capacity

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the request form with availability-based booking (service menu, bay capacity, confirmation by text/email) and drop the CAPTCHA gate so an agent can complete a booking
top_opportunities.evidence: Schedule page states the time is not guaranteed, promises a 24-hour manual reply, and is protected by Google reCAPTCHA

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add AutoRepair/LocalBusiness JSON-LD (address, hours, geo, services, aggregateRating) and publish reviews as text on the Reviews page
top_opportunities.evidence: Only an Organization schema block exists; Reviews page only links to Google and SureCritic

top_opportunities.opportunity: Appointment confirmation, reminder and declined-service follow-up agent: auto-confirm bookings, chase no-shows and re-offer deferred brake/tire work
top_opportunities.evidence: Manual 24-hour confirmation promise plus high-ticket deferred maintenance lines (brakes, tires, alignments)

scores.reasons: A long-established shop with a good template site, so the gap is specific: no true booking, weak schema, reviews not on-page. It sells high-ticket repair and fleet work and has operated since 1996, so ability to pay is solid. Booking replacement is a medium build; schema and review fixes are quick. Evidence is unusually strong - site, hours, forms, robots.txt and ratings were all observed directly.

name: BLOOM Custom Hair Color

customers: Color-seeking clients (bold fashion color, blonding, corrective color) in Highland Park and surrounding towns; new clients pay a $50-60 deposit.

size_signals.signal: Multiple stylists - the review carousel names at least one (Jada Haynes)
Team page plus portfolio and shop sections in the site nav
Open six days: Tue-Sat 8am-7pm, Monday closed (footer hours)

listing.platform: Magicpin aggregated listing (Google count not verified); the site itself displays 197 GlossGenius reviews

website_review.online_booking_or_quote: yes - GlossGenius booking with service list, prices, durations and deposits
website_review.trust_signals: 197 reviews embedded on site, real client portfolio photos, team page, published prices and deposits, hours in footer
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Slight horizontal overflow on desktop (document 1440px vs 1425px viewport); no phone number anywhere on the site (only address and hours); the whole web presence lives on a glossgenius.com subdomain rather than their own domain
website_review.search_basics: Title is "BLOOM | Hair Salon in Highland Park, NJ" - good; HairSalon JSON-LD present; services, prices and durations in text; but pages are client-rendered and the site sits on a booking-platform subdomain, and a robots.txt was not readable at the subdomain root
top_issues: No phone number or click-to-call anywhere - clients with questions must book or hunt for contact info
No owned domain: everything sits on a glossgenius.com subdomain
Booking button is inside the hamburger menu on mobile
Content renders client-side, which makes it harder for crawlers and answer engines to read

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: HairSalon JSON-LD present and title names the town, but the site is a booking-platform subdomain (weaker for local search) and the Google Business Profile could not be verified. Answerable: services, prices, durations, deposits, address and hours are all real text. Bookable: GlossGenius checkout with per-service Book buttons and no CAPTCHA in the way - the closest to agent-bookable in this batch.

operations_signals.signal: New clients pay a deposit at booking, which suggests no-shows and deposit control (inference)
No phone published, so intake is funneled into online booking (inference)
Shop section in the nav suggests retail/product orders handled alongside appointments (inference)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add a visible phone number/click-to-call and a contact option for pre-booking color questions
top_opportunities.evidence: No phone number appears anywhere on the site; only address and hours.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Move to an owned domain with a GlossGenius booking widget, and put Book Now in the mobile header
top_opportunities.evidence: Site is hosted at bloomcustomhair.glossgenius.com; mobile header shows only cart and hamburger icons.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automate post-visit review requests so the 197 GlossGenius reviews also accumulate on Google
top_opportunities.evidence: Site shows 197 reviews while the third-party listing shows only 14 ratings.

scores.reasons: Gap: small - already bookable with priced services; missing phone/contact and own domain. Ability: color-led menu with $120-450 services and deposits, plus 197 reviews. Ease: GlossGenius handles booking, so changes are content and domain work. Evidence: site, service pages, schema and mobile view inspected.

name: Reboot It Tech Service - South River

customers: Households and individuals in South River, Sayreville, Parlin, Spotswood, Milltown, Old Bridge and East Brunswick.

size_signals.signal: Owner describes it as 'a one-woman show' and a part-time business alongside a full-time job; established 2017
Home-office, appointment-only model with pickup/drop-off; no storefront

website_review.primary_cta: 'Book an appointment!' button in the body linking to a JotForm appointment request
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: JotForm appointment request form (external; no form on the site itself)
website_review.trust_signals: Established-in-2017 line, service-area list, woman-owned and Latina-owned badges, Google profile at 4.9 with 19 reviews
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Google Sites single-page layout, no nav, no description metadata, no phone number visible on the page, no robots.txt
website_review.search_basics: Page title is just the business name with no service or town keywords; no meta description; one page for all services
top_issues: Phone number is not on the page and there are no tel: links, so mobile visitors must copy it from elsewhere
Everything is a single Google Sites page with no service pages or metadata
Booking hands off to an external JotForm with no follow-up automation visible

agent_readiness.notes: Google profile is claimed and unusually complete: 4.9 with 19 reviews, real hours, phone, both website links, owner photos/videos and identity attributes. There is no robots.txt (404) so nothing is blocked. Readable text explains services, service area and the appointment-only model, but there is no pricing, no JSON-LD and no street address — reasonable for a home business. Booking is an external JotForm an agent could fill, though it is an appointment request rather than a confirmed slot.

operations_signals.signal: Owner states text is the best way to reach her and that same-day availability is limited — manual message triage is the bottleneck
Appointment requests flow into JotForm with a repair/service agreement and liability waiver, i.e. paperwork handled per job

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add an SMS/chat intake agent that answers common repair questions, quotes typical jobs and proposes appointment slots — the owner already prefers text and is time-poor
top_opportunities.evidence: Site says 'Text is the best way to contact me', it is a part-time one-woman business and same-day availability is limited

top_opportunities.opportunity: Put the phone number and a tap-to-text link in the page header and replace the Google Sites page with two or three service pages with proper titles
top_opportunities.evidence: No tel: links on the page, no meta description, single-page site

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automate post-repair review requests and follow-ups from the JotForm submissions to grow the 19-review base
top_opportunities.evidence: Booking runs through JotForm with no visible follow-up automation

scores.reasons: Repair jobs are low-ticket and the business is explicitly part-time, so budget is thin; the gaps are real (no phone link, single page, manual texts) but modest in value, and the listing data was fully visible.

name: Globo Auto BMW Specialist
what_they_do: BMW/European specialist shop doing routine service plus engine swaps, ECU tuning, suspension and full performance builds; the site showcases named customer builds (E92 M3, F30 335i, E46 S54 swap). Also runs an online parts store and posts builds on Instagram.
customers: BMW/Audi/Mercedes/Infiniti owners, including enthusiasts travelling from other towns for performance work and engine swaps

size_signals.signal: 278 Google reviews at 4.9 — far above the other shops in this batch
'12+ years' / 'since 2012', all staff ASE certified (self-reported on site)
Google profile lists only instagram.com — no website on the listing despite having a full site; owner has posted workshop photos/videos within the last month

website_review.primary_cta: Click-to-call button in the hero (tel:+17323872281) plus 'VIEW OUR BUILDS' / 'VIEW ALL SERVICES'
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: contact form on /contact with name, phone, email, vehicle, service dropdown and message — but the form has no action attribute and delivery could not be verified without submitting; no calendar-based online booking (walk-ins only)
website_review.trust_signals: ASE certification claims, 12+ years, real workshop and build photos, customer builds with model/year detail, 278 Google reviews linked from the site, Instagram accounts
website_review.out_of_date_signs: None obvious; © 2026, Next.js site, recent content. Minor: a stray blue vertical bar renders at the left edge on mobile and the hero animates in slowly.
website_review.search_basics: Strong: unique title/description per page ('Contact Globo Auto — South River, NJ'), separate /services, /performance, /builds, /store, /about pages, city named throughout, and AutoRepair + LocalBusiness JSON-LD with address, telephone and opening hours.

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: listing has category, hours, phone, recent owner photos and 278 reviews, but the website field is missing (Google shows 'Add website' and only instagram.com) — a real findability leak. robots.txt (Cloudflare-managed) allows 'User-agent: *', so OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Googlebot are fine, though it blocks GPTBot, ClaudeBot and Google-Extended. Answerable: hours, services, makes serviced and vehicle-specific build details are plain text, and LocalBusiness JSON-LD matches the page. Bookable: labelled form fields capture vehicle and service type, but no booking calendar and form delivery is unproven.

operations_signals.signal: Walk-in/phone-only scheduling ('Walk-ins welcome', no calendar) — the site's form is the only async channel and it has no action attribute
High enquiry volume implied by 278 reviews and active Instagram parts accounts (@globo.parts) — quotes and parts questions likely eat staff time (inference)
Online /store selling parts alongside the shop means order questions and repair enquiries arrive on the same channels

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add the website URL to the Google Business Profile (and complete services/photos there) — the listing currently points only at Instagram
top_opportunities.evidence: Maps panel shows 'Add website' and lists instagram.com under the profile while globoauto.shop is live with full service pages

top_opportunities.opportunity: Turn the existing contact form into a real quote/booking request: wire it to a backend or form service, add a booking calendar with drop-off slots, and auto-respond with next steps
top_opportunities.evidence: The /contact form has no action attribute and no visible handler; fields exist (name, phone, email, vehicle, service, message) but nothing confirms delivery; there is no scheduling calendar anywhere

top_opportunities.opportunity: AI assistant for build/parts enquiries — qualifies vehicle + goal, quotes typical ranges, books a drop-off
top_opportunities.evidence: Inference from 278 reviews plus two Instagram parts accounts and a /store: high inbound volume across repairs, performance work and parts orders with no async qualification path

scores.reasons: The site is already well built (schema, service pages, click-to-call), so remaining gaps are narrow: website missing from the GBP, unverified form, no online booking. High-ticket performance builds and 278 reviews suggest real budget. Work needs care because the site is a Next.js build and any booking flow touches existing pages. Evidence is strong — I read the live pages, robots.txt and JSON-LD.

name: R.A. Nichols Home Services (R.A. Nichols Plumbing, Heating & Air)
what_they_do: Residential plumbing and HVAC contractor offering drain and sewer work, water heaters, AC repair and installation, heating/furnace/boiler service, plus 24/7 emergency service. customers: Homeowners in Helmetta, Monroe Township and surrounding Middlesex County towns; some light commercial.

size_signals.signal: NJ Plumbing #11691 and NJ HVAC #19HC00263900 listed in site footer; NJ licensed contractor
Uses ServiceTitan online scheduler and a self-serve 'Instant HVAC Quote' journey - indicates a real back office and dispatch software
Wrapped service van and crew photos on site; 'Meet the Local Plumbing & HVAC Experts' team section
Owner says family-owned since 2007

website_review.primary_cta: Call (732) 927-1945 / Book Online / Instant HVAC Quote
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Book Online opens an embedded ServiceTitan scheduler (zip check, then scheduling); separate Instant HVAC Quote flow in /shop/
website_review.trust_signals: Licence numbers in footer, 4.9-star review wall, Daikin Comfort Pro badge, financing, real van/crew photos, 24/7 emergency line
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Copyright is current (2026). However the Helmetta service-area page still carries 'Monroe Township' image alt text (untouched template) and a stale phone number.
website_review.search_basics: Home page title 'Plumber Monroe | HVAC Monroe | RA Nichols Home Services' and description name the service and a town, but not Helmetta. Town-specific service-area pages exist for Helmetta with their own H2 service blocks.
top_issues: Three different phone numbers across properties: (732) 927-1945 on the home page, (609) 640-3394 on the Helmetta service-area page, (732) 896-2821 on the Google listing.
No opening hours written anywhere on the site, and 'Book Online' is an href='#' anchor that only works if JS injects the scheduler - a crawler or agent sees a dead link.
Helmetta page uses Monroe Township image alt text; no price ranges or diagnostic-fee text anywhere a crawler or agent can read.

agent_readiness.notes: GBP is claimed and complete (Plumber category, address, 'Open 24 hours', site link, book-online link, owner post 4 days ago, photos). robots.txt explicitly allows OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot. LocalBusiness/Plumber/HVACBusiness JSON-LD is present and matches the page. Deductions: hours conflict (GBP says open 24 hours, Birdeye says 7:30-4, site states none) so an agent cannot answer 'when are you open' reliably; phone number conflict; booking is only reachable through JS, not a plain link or documented API.

operations_signals.signal: Markets 24/7 emergency service but the site lists no hours and the dispatch line is human - after-hours intake is the obvious automation target
Separate 'Instant HVAC Quote' journey plus ServiceTitan booking means quote-to-booking handoffs and follow-up already exist in software and could be automated

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the NAP mess and publish machine-readable hours, service list and price ranges (diagnostic fee, flat-rate examples) so AI agents and Google quote the right phone, hours and cost
top_opportunities.evidence: Three phone numbers across site/GBP/service-area page; 'Open 24 hours' on GBP vs 7:30-4 on Birdeye vs nothing on the site

top_opportunities.opportunity: AI voice/chat intake for after-hours and overflow calls that captures address, system type and issue, then books into ServiceTitan
top_opportunities.evidence: 24/7 emergency positioning with a phone-only front door; booking is a JS-gated scheduler

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated review requests and responses at scale (734 reviews) plus cleanup of templated town pages
top_opportunities.evidence: 4.9/734 on Google but 895 unclaimed reviews on Birdeye; Helmetta page still has Monroe Township alt text

scores.reasons: Gap is small - site is modern, books online and has schema - but NAP/hours conflicts are real. Ability to pay is high: licensed multi-trade shop, ServiceTitan, branded fleet, 734 Google reviews. Moderate ease because fixes are cheap but deeper automation touches their dispatch stack. Evidence is strong, seen directly on site and Maps.
